formulas: idx = id - *(mgr+0x30) (base); valid if id!=-1 && (id!=0||*(mgr+0x30)==0) && *(mgr+0x28)!=0 (stride) && 0<=idx<*(mgr+0x24) (count)
row = *(*(mgr+0x20) + (idx / *(mgr+0x28))*4); return *(row + (idx % *(mgr+0x28))*4)
functions.serverRelevance: data: equipment random-passive-skill activation-set definitions. Used by FUN_1085ab40 to expand a rolled passive's activate list. Server owns the roll & activation; this is client read-side (base@0x30,count@0x24,stride@0x28,blocks@0x20).

functions.purpose: AS provider: given a pet-skill handle (AS arg @+8), resolves the skill object (FUN_10540d00 -> FUN_116c05c0 -> FUN_1050ef40 record) and writes skillPoint, intimate, quality, skilltype from the record.
formulas: record iVar2 offsets: skillPoint=*(rec+0x64), intimate=*(rec+0x68), quality=*(rec+0x70), skilltype=*(rec+0x58)
AS input value @ in_stack_00000010+8 when tag (&0x8f) in {3,4} else 0xdeadbeaf
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO; confirms pet-skill record offsets (skillPoint@0x64, intimate@0x68, quality@0x70, skilltype@0x58) consistent with FUN_10518600.

functions.purpose: Builds the charm / random-passive-skill VO (param_5==9 required). Resolves the equip/charm object (branches: hidden-skill path FUN_113f9bb0, normal FUN_10858a70, or FUN_10858670), validates via FUN_116698a0/FUN_1166e120, then emits title, charmFoundTimes, and an 'arrayRandPassiveSkillDesc' array. Each rolled passive can be hidden (bIsHidden, with nVisibleMoney unlock cost) and carries an 'activateInfoList' of ACTIVATE_VO entries (nType per activation, expanded via CEquipRandPassiveSkillActivateSetInfo).
formulas: gate: param_5==9; requires equip obj (DAT_1202e818->0xd0->0x90 vtbl+0xb4) with *(obj+0x2d1c)!=0
charmFoundTimes = piVar5[0x7b]
passive-desc loop count = (uStack_f4 - piStack_f8)/0x1c (stride 0x1c per input desc); entry fields: iStack_9c(=bIsHidden flag, ==1), skill group @+8/+0xc
bIsHidden = (entry[0]==1); if hidden: nVisibleMoney = CEquipHiddenSkillCondOpenInfo::GetInfoManagerInstance(skill via vtbl[0x2c]/vtbl[0x18])
hidden-name string id: 0x13a5 + (skillIdx<0) ; charm title string id 0x13a4
activateInfoList: iterate FUN_10856700(uStack_a4)->+0x2c list [4]..[5] stride 4; per activate nType = vtbl[0x10](); value via FUN_1085a0c0
costs: nVisibleMoney = money required to reveal a hidden random-passive skill (server-authoritative unlock cost)
functions.serverRelevance: validation/data: displays server-rolled random passive skills on a charm/equip. Server owns the roll (see CEquipRandPassiveSkillSubGroupInfo in schema) and the hidden-skill unlock cost (nVisibleMoney). Client only renders; the reveal action is server-validated.
